# 爱词吧 (iCiBa) - 金山词霸背单词网站

> > Online vocabulary learning platform by 金山词霸 (Kingsoft PowerWord) offering structured English word memorization courses for Chinese learners.

爱词吧 (iCiBa) is the official vocabulary learning website under 金山词霸 (Kingsoft PowerWord), providing free online courses and word lists designed to help Chinese speakers systematically memorize and master English vocabulary through lesson-based learning methods.

## Key Topics

- 爱词吧 (iCiBa)
- 金山词霸 (Kingsoft PowerWord)
- vocabulary-learning
- word-memorization
- online-course
- chinese-language
- lesson-based-learning
- free-course
- English vocabulary
- 背单词 (memorizing words)
- 单词表 (word lists)
- 在线学习 (online learning)

## Vocabulary Learning Courses

- [要背就背有用单词 - Practical English Words Course](https://word.iciba.com/?action=courses&classid=713): Comprehensive vocabulary course focused on practical and useful English words for Chinese learners, featuring structured lessons and free online memorization tools
